title: The Quiet Locker
author: Kestrel Thornbury
blurb: Edmund Reyes, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
